stresses: routing correctness: findings alternate among 3 questions; multi-question findings cited without copies
description: Q3's shallow dependencies (F29 needs only F01, F30 only F02, F34 nothing) let the detection question interleave from the second sitting, even though canonically it emerges late. assertions.expect: Q3 opens as a real section-or-stub from its own findings (F29, F34) in the second sitting, days before the causal work matures - question emergence follows evidence, not the canonical late position

F20, emitted in a Q1-anchored sitting but tagged Q1 and Q2, is cited under both sections as one entity without copies, and its overturn of F03 propagates to the Q2 attribution regardless of the anchor
F21 and F27 (Q1+Q2) are reachable from both sections; the Q1 citations carry the impact framing (exposure percentages) while Q2 citations carry the mechanism framing - one entity, two roles
Q1, Q2, and Q3 sections each developed in parallel across interleaved sittings; no section's prose duplicates another's account of a shared finding
every out-of-anchor placement was a visible proposal or receipt; nothing was routed across an anchor silently
each sitting is findable from every section it touched (touched-set indexing), not only from its anchor
